**Repair only.** Two fixes, both found on the second playthrough, both proven before this was
cut. Nothing new.

## The Anatomist perk finally does something

Sell the fish monger fifteen vodyanoi skulls and he shows you the soft spot behind the eye --
that was 0.6.0, and the perk it gave you did nothing at all, however you fought. It does now:
**every landed hit on a vodyanoi does an extra 4-10 piercing damage**, shown as its own number,
with fists, blades, bows or spells alike. If you already hold the perk it works from the next
vodyanoi you meet; creatures you have already fought were spawned with the old script and won't
count.

## The goblin in Scar Ravine

Stand over the goblin holding the woodcutter's daughter and tell him to try, or buy her off him
with a season of salt pork, and he answered as if you'd invoked the Goblin Khan. He didn't know
who you were; now he answers what you actually said.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over 0.9.2 as normal. Both fixes work on
any save.
